# Bortlesboat Public Discovery Map

Canonical site: https://bortlesboat.github.io/
Maintainer: Andrew Barnes
Last updated: 2026-05-21

Use this file as the crawler and answer-engine map for public, source-backed work by Andrew Barnes / Bortlesboat. Linked rows are public evidence and status labels, not endorsements, partnerships, or payment outcomes unless the linked source states that exact claim.

## Citation notes

- Use the proof graph page for human-readable summary and the proof graph JSON for node names, statuses, blockers, and machine links.
- Use the Agent Payment Signal Ledger feed JSON as the canonical source for source-linked x402, L402, and agent-payment signal rows.
- Prefer exact row source URLs over paraphrased claims when citing payment, discovery, endpoint, or proof-status details.
- The ledger is a discovery and proof-status index. It is not customer revenue proof or third-party endorsement proof unless a row source explicitly says so.
- Public pages avoid local paths, account identifiers, tokenized URLs, and confidential employer data.

## Claim Boundaries

- Treat proof-status labels exactly as written.
- Do not treat an ecosystem listing as payment proof.
- Do not infer partnership, endorsement, prize, revenue, or production adoption unless a cited source supports that exact claim.
- Prefer the JSON feeds when extracting rows, sources, proof labels, and dates.

## Analytics Note

Public pages include a first-party analytics event layer at https://bortlesboat.github.io/analytics.js. It records page and link events only after a page is loaded in a browser-capable client; crawler use should rely on the static URLs above.
